title: LiteBans Discord Bridge
description: Configurable Discord Webhooks for LiteBans Events on Velocity, Bungeecord, Paper and Spigot.
body:
![Plugin Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4343f605f704a18326d44b7b56b34869009945bc_0.webp)
LiteBans Discord Bridge is a small utility plugin made to send any LiteBans events from your Minecraft Network or server, into a Discord channel.


It supports a global webhook and granular webhooks-per-event, and has full embed customisation with placeholders and more.


**NOTE: THE DOWNLOADS PROVIDED ON MODRINTH ARE COMPILED WITH JAVA 8. FOR A *TINY* PERFORMANCE BOOST, YOU CAN VISIT GITHUB TO DOWNLOAD THE [JAVA 21 COMPILATIONS](https://github.com/colocated/LitebansDiscordBridge/releases/latest) OF THE PLUGIN.**


![Requirements header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a16d6e70e86e2d0c8ff41ca748b589cb5f0220f4.png)
As would be somewhat obvious, you're required to have a valid copy of LiteBans on your server. \
You can purchase a copy of Litebans over at [SpigotMC](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/litebans.3715/). It is a paid plugin, so it's not included in this _free download_.

![Installation header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c43838f464bbef237cbe4895605288f0f583cb0d.png)
Installing the plugin is super easy. \
Make sure to select the correct platform JAR for your product. \
For more information about which JAR to select, visit the [Latest GitHub Release](https://github.com/colocated/LitebansDiscordBridge/releases/latest).


Drag and drop the plugin file into your platform's plugins folder and restart the server. \
The plugins configuration directory will create automatically on first load, and you'll be able to edit the plugin over at **plugins/litebansdiscordbridge/config.yml**.


There are many placeholders that the plugin supports - check out the default config file for more information on how to use them.


![Get support header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9bdff5087a76723828d91980c42e0ea8bb1679fe.png)

This plugin is open source, and thus provided as-is and free of charge. \
Compiled versions are available at Modrinth or [GitHub](https://github.com/colocated/LitebansDiscordBridge/releases/latest).


[Pull requests](https://github.com/colocated/LitebansDiscordBridge/pulls) and [issues](https://github.com/colocated/LitebansDiscordBridge/issues) are welcome on the relevant GitHub pages. \
Please try to be descriptive if you want me to be able to fix an issue. "It isn't working" is NOT a bug report!


If you're somehow really stuck with the plugin, you can message me on Discord **@colocated** - I'll try my best to help, but no support is guaranteed as standard.
